claim_limits: symbolic solver and deterministic verifier remain authoritative
forced hints are measured as a safety contrast, not trusted
no LLM, hardware, or generated text judge execution

field_principles.conflict_delta_vs_solver_only: conflict-count delta for overwrite-capable mode versus solver-only baseline.
field_principles.fallback_completeness_rate: fraction of cases where fallback solver still returns the correct answer when hints fail.
field_principles.forced_hint_harm_rate: fraction of cases where forced hints worsen conflicts/search/validity.
field_principles.harmful_hint_classes: list of hint classes that harmed performance or validity.
field_principles.overwrite_hint_harm_rate: fraction of cases where overwrite-capable hints worsen conflicts/search/validity.
field_principles.overwrite_rate: fraction of hinted decisions overwritten by the solver.
field_principles.overwrite_solver_guidance_ready: true only if no-hint, forced-hint, and overwrite-capable modes are all compared under solver authority.
field_principles.post_projection_validity_rate: fraction of returned solutions passing deterministic verifier.
field_principles.solver_authoritative: must be true; solver/verifier decides validity.
field_principles.status: complete only if all solver-guidance modes are measured.
field_principles.tests_run: list of commands run or no-code-change explanation.
field_principles.unsafe_false_accepts: count of invalid solutions accepted as valid.

honest_verdict: complete: overwrite-capable routing preserved solver-authoritative validity while forced bad hints exposed bounded harm
